name: Dino Hunters[UPD]
desc:
🦖 Welcome to Dino Hunters!

Grab your weapon and enter a prehistoric world! Shoot, capture, and train powerful dinosaurs. Upgrade and evolve your dino team, battle in exciting dino fights, explore new worlds, and discover rare dinosaurs!

🔫 Shoot dinosaurs
🦕 Catch and collect dinos to build your strongest team
⬆️ Evolve, upgrade, and rank up
🌍 Explore new worlds & discover new dinos

Become the ultimate Dino Hunter!
